name: Runefather's Boast
description: Grants additional Armour, Evasion Rating, and Stun Threshold.
keywordDefinition:
You can have up to 10,000 Runefather's Boast Buffs.

Each Runefather's Boast grants +1 to Armour, +1 to Evasion Rating, and +1 to Stun Threshold.

Runefather's Boast does not have a duration, but is lost when you die or change area.
